verdict.rationale: Formant's own docs say events can trigger actions: events can trigger commands on the device, and webhooks fire HTTP calls to any endpoint based on a Formant event. Its operations pages also claim configurable alerts and automated incident response. However, the evidence never documents how event rules are defined: no condition syntax, thresholds, filters or rule-builder depth, and no independent or hands-on corroboration. That leaves coverage partial. Missing for 10: documented rule/condition definition model (thresholds, filters, scoping), breadth of trigger types and chained actions, programmatic or AI-native rule authoring, independent corroboration.
